## Bad event

A colluding monitor passes real attacks while flagging honeypots, or honeypot-measured recall misstates real recall. Claim: success ≤ (1+TV)/2 and |FNR_real − FNR_honeypot| ≤ TV (collusion_uniform, pass_transfer), applicable only if the monitor's decision depends only on the stated view. (REVIEW-PACKET finding 10: the bound is the claim; the bad event is the adversary's success.)
